subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/wake delivery-context fix for this issue?
rationale: The code-level remaining gap is clear, but multiple stale or conflicting linked PRs already claim the work, and choosing whether to adopt, replace, or close them is maintainer coordination rather than a safe new repair dispatch.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked fixes
options.body: Use the existing candidate PRs as source material, but land one narrow current-main fix with live or high-quality Mattermost thread proof for the cron/wake path.

options.title: Keep waiting on contributor PRs
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the open closing PRs until their authors rebase, supply proof, and resolve conflicts.

options.title: Narrow the issue to message-tool only
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally split the cron/wake behavior to another canonical issue and preserve the link there.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the linked fixes
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate PRs as source material, but land one narrow current-main fix with live or high-quality Mattermost thread proof for the cron/wake path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent area history and current-main ownership signals make this the best available routing candidate for choosing a replacement or adoption path.
